Condition: every model in your army has the CHAOS keyword
Result: army may include either 1 TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS model or up to 3 WAR DOG models (even without the Faction keyword chosen in the Select Army Faction step)
Restriction: none of these models can be your WARLORD or be given Enhancements

Condition: Army Faction CHAOS KNIGHTS
Timing: start of battle rounds 1, 3 and 5
Select: optionally 1 other Dread ability, or 2 random Dread abilities using 2D6
Result:
- units in your army with this ability: active Dread abilities gained
- **Deathly Terror** active from battle start
Restriction: same Dread ability selected at most once
Random duplicates: no additional effect
Duration: selected Dread abilities active until end of battle

- 5: **Delirium** (Aura)
- 6: **Dominion**

chaosknights/rules/army_rules/Super-heav:
Each Normal, Advance or Fall Back move by a model with this ability
May move through:
- models (not TITANIC models)
- terrain feature sections ≤4" in height
While doing so:
- may move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end the move within Engagement Range of them
- may also move through terrain feature sections >4" in height
If it moved through a section >4" in height, after the move:
Roll 1D6:
- 1: that model Battle-shocked
